base.description: Center of galactic commerce. The three-deck Grand Bazaar moves goods from every empire, but it's the Promenade that moves credits — restaurants serving Solarian rations, cantinas pouring Crimson bloodwine, and neural arcades powered by Voidborn matrices keep visitors spending long past when they planned to leave. The Collective takes its cut of everything.
base.name: Grand Exchange Station

condition.condition_text: Multiple systems running on emergency reserves. Lights flicker in the corridors.
